localizedValues.name: 1 - Kinney Lake
localizedValues.description: Kinney Lake campground has 18 tent pads and is located 7 km from the trailhead with an elevation of 984m/3230 ft. The campground has a day-use shelter, picnic tables, outhouse and food storage. It is an easy hike along the Robson River through an old growth cedar forest. The hike is very suitable for inexperienced hikers and families with small children. Bikes are allowed along the trail. Pets, hammocks and fires are not permitted. Campers must register at the Visitor Centre before departing on the trail. A reservation guarantees a tent pad at the campground. Tents are required and tent pad selection is first come, first served upon arrival at the campground.

localizedValues.name: 2 - Whitehorn
localizedValues.description: Whitehorn campground has 22 tent pads and is located 11 Km from the trailhead with an elevation of 1097m/3600 ft. The campground has a day-use shelter, outhouse and food storage. A good destination for hikers that only have one night on the trail. Mount Robson and the Valley of a Thousand Falls are viewable from this campground. Bikes, pets, hammocks and fires are not permitted. Campers must register at the Visitor Centre before departing on the trail. A reservation guarantees a tent pad at the campground. Tents are required and tent pad selection is first come, first served upon arrival at the campground.

localizedValues.name: 3 - Emperor Falls
localizedValues.description: Emperor Falls campground has 9 tent pads and is located 16 Km from the trailhead with an elevation of 1615m/5300 ft. The campground has an outhouse and food storage. It is an easy day hike to access to Berg Lake. Campground offers solitude and splendid views. Bikes, pets, hammocks and fires are not permitted. Campers must register at the Visitor Centre before departing on the trail. A reservation guarantees a tent pad at the campground. Tents are required and tent pad selection is first come, first served upon arrival at the campground.

localizedValues.name: 4 - Marmot
localizedValues.description: Marmot campground has 7 tent pads and is located 19 Km from the trailhead with an elevation of 1645m/5400 ft. The campground has food storage and an outhouse. With only 7 tent pads, this campground is well-suited for those seeking a quieter experience. Bikes, pets, hammocks and fires are not permitted. Campers must register at the Visitor Centre before departing on the trail. A reservation guarantees a tent pad at the campground. Tents are required and tent pad selection is first come, first served upon arrival at the campground.

localizedValues.name: 5 - Berg Lake
localizedValues.description: Berg Lake campground has 26 tent pads and is located 21 km from the trailhead with an elevation of 1641m/5385 ft. The campground has a day-use shelter, outhouses and food storage. This popular campground is a great place to meet fellow hikers and to enjoy views of the Berg Glacier and Berg Lake. Numerous day hikes can be accessed from this campground. A ranger station is located 1.5 KM north-east of this campground for hikers requiring information or assistance. Bikes, pets, hammocks and fires are not permitted. Campers must register at the Visitor Centre before departing on the trail. A reservation guarantees a tent pad at the campground. Tents are required and tent pad selection is first come, first served upon arrival at the campground.

localizedValues.name: 6 - Rearguard
localizedValues.description: Rearguard campground has 6 tent pads and is located 22 km from the trailhead with an elevation of 1646m/5400 ft. The campground has an outhouse and food storage. The smallest of the 7 campgrounds on the Berg Lake Trail, Rearguard is named for the peak just east of Berg Lake. Campers can plan to experience a quiet, uncrowded backcountry setting with beautiful views. Bikes, pets, hammocks and fires are not permitted. Campers must register at the Visitor Centre before departing on the trail. A reservation guarantees a tent pad at the campground. Tents are required and tent pad selection is first come, first served upon arrival at the campground.

localizedValues.name: 7 - Robson Pass
localizedValues.description: Robson Pass campground has 15 tent pads and is located 23 km from the trailhead with an elevation of 1649m/5410 ft. The campground has an outhouse and food storage. This is the last campground on the Berg Lake Trail and is popular with climbers due to its proximity to the Robson Glacier and it's routes to the summit of Mount Robson. Jasper National Parks North Boundary Trail and Mount Robson Park's Moose River Route can be accessed from this location. Bikes, pets, hammocks and fires are not permitted. Campers must register at the Visitor Centre before departing on the trail. A reservation guarantees a tent pad at the campground. Tents are required and tent pad selection is first come, first served upon arrival at the campground.
